release_notes:
Manual rejection review, per-order API re-routing & mobile-friendly UI

Admin: manually verify supplier rejections before customers are refunded/notified (per-service toggle holds rejects for review; approve or re-route to another API), plus per-order Connect-to-API to repoint/requeue any order and a dashboard action indicator. Fixes: add-credits error names the actual payment method; PHP 8 hardening. Mobile/responsive polish across admin orders and the client dashboard (2-up tiles, centered donuts, compact prompts, redesigned nav & profile menu) — desktop unchanged.
